item.title: Report: Citi Bank Predicts New Red Dead Game Could Launch by 2027-2028
item.description: Investment bank Citi says a new Red Dead title could arrive in 2027 or 2028, but Rockstar's development cycle may make that timeline unrealistic.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Leaker 'Cyberleek' Quits After Meme Coin Crash, Ending at Risk via Dead Man’s Switch
item.description: Credible RockstarINTEL reports that the notorious GTA 6 leaker 'Cyberleek' has ceased sharing content following a failed meme coin venture, leaving fans worried about unverified claims of a dead man’s switch protecting the game's ending.

item.title: Report: Real Life GTA 6 Vehicles Are Driving Around Miami as Part of Rockstar Marketing Push
item.description: GameRant reports that Rockstar Games has deployed real-world vehicles modded to resemble Grand Theft Auto 6 cars on the streets of Miami as part of the game's marketing campaign. item.title: New GTA 6 Screenshot and Launch Trailer Artwork Released
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports a brand new GTA 6 screenshot and launch trailer artwork featuring protagonists Jason and Lucia, confirming the November 19, 2026 release date.

item.title: GTA Online Event Week: Halloween Event Continues (October 15th-21st){
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that GTA Online's Halloween Event Week runs from October 15 to 21, extending the month-long Halloween event with fresh spooky missions, new rewards, and updated bonuses.

item.title: Report: RockstarINTEL Reports Claimed Final GTA 6 Leak Includes Ending Snippet as Leaker Quits
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports a claimed final GTA 6 leak includes an ending snippet as the leaker says he is quitting; all claims are attributed to the outlet and treated as unverified.

item.title: GTA 6 Release Date, Review Timing and Insider Details Ahead of November 19
item.description: According to Gamespot, Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled for release on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but the exact timing of review publication has not been confirmed. item.title: Rockstar Says GTA 6 Will Speed Up Future Game Development
item.description: Rockstar says GTA 6's development tools and team will let them build the next game faster, cutting the typical eight‑year wait.

item.title: New GTA 6 Screenshots Revealed via Bloomberg Interview
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports two new official GTA 6 screenshots shared by Bloomberg after Jason Schreier’s interview with Rockstar North staff, showing Lucia in mud and a fresh Pegassi model.

item.title: GTA 6 PC Port Could Arrive Within Three Months of Console Launch
item.description: GameSpot reports that Rockstar Games may release Grand Theft Auto 6 on PC in early 2027, just a few months after its planned November 2026 console debut.

item.title: New GTA 6 Merch Released Alongside Art Museum Exhibition
item.description: Rockstar releases new GTA 6 merchandise and partners with Wynwood Walls Museum for a Stockyard-themed exhibition, featuring artwork from over a dozen artists.

item.title: GTA 6 Boxed Copies Sold Out At Some Retailers
item.description: GTA 6 physical editions are selling out ahead of the November 12 release, with Amazon US and Target reporting sold‑out pre‑orders as Rockstar maintains limited quantities.

item.title: GTA 6 Leak Shows Lucia Skydiving Naked in New Crypto‑Driven Footage
item.description: Kotaku reports that a GTA 6 leaker posted grainy footage of Lucia skydiving naked to promote a crypto token, claiming further releases depend on the coin’s market cap.

item.title: GTA 6 Leaker CyberLeek Shares New Video Featuring Lucia
item.description: Eurogamer reports CyberLeek posted a five-minute GTA 6 clip featuring Lucia in Leonida, including a parachute jump and content that may be a debug feature.

item.title: GTA 6 Leak Hacker Trial Begins 10 Days Before Release
item.description: Notebookcheck reports that an individual accused of leaking GTA 6 gameplay footage is scheduled to go on trial approximately 10 days before the game's expected release date. The publication identified the legal proceeding as occurring in the near term, marking a significant development in the ongoin

item.title: GTA 6 Leaker CyberLeek Reportedly Threatens Full Playable Build
item.description: Eurogamer reports that GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek has threatened to release a complete, playable build of the game from start to finish, demanding a $30 million cryptocurrency market cap.

item.title: Is GTA 6 Coming to Switch 2? Ask Rockstar, Nintendo Says
item.description: Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard defers any announcement on Grand Theft Auto 6 for Switch 2, telling fans the decision rests with Take‑Two/Rockstar.

item.title: GTA 6 Reveals 6 Radio Stations and On-Foot Podcasts
item.description: Rockstar Games has revealed six new radio stations for Grand Theft Auto 6 and confirmed a series first: players can listen to on-demand podcasts and music on foot. According to GameSpot, the announcement details the stations and their host DJs, while Eurogamer confirms the audio mechanics.

item.title: GTA Online Background Patch Fixes Kortz Heist Glitches
item.description: Rockstar Games has quietly released a new background patch for GTA Online, according to a report by RockstarINTEL citing dataminer Tex2. item.title: GTA 6 Radio Hosts Revealed: Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, Kerry King
item.description: Rockstar confirms Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy and Kerry King as GTA 6 radio hosts.

item.title: GTA+ Month 55 Launches with Free Vehicles and Discounts
item.description: Rockstar announces new GTA+ Month 55 perks including the Pegassi Oppressor as a free vehicle, Vinewood Car Club discounts, and new Chameleon Paints. Available until November 4th.

item.title: GTA 6 Screenshots: Rockstar Reveals New Vice City Views
item.description: Rockstar Games has released three new Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots alongside in-engine radio station backgrounds, showcasing the vibrant streets of Vice City.

item.title: GTA 6 Wanted System Overhaul: Hit-and-Run Mechanics Detailed by Rockstar
item.description: GameSpot reports that Rockstar Games' head of development Rob Nelson described a revamped wanted system in GTA 6 during an IGN interview. item.title: Xbox Secures Exclusive Streaming Rights for GTA 6 at Launch, According to The Verge
item.description: Xbox head Asha Sharma announced that Xbox has obtained exclusive game streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto VI at launch, per The Verge, enabling play via Xbox Cloud Gaming while the length of the exclusivity period remains unspecified.

item.title: Dan Houser Explains Why He’s Staying Away From GTA 6 and Open‑World Games
item.description: In a recent interview, Rockstar co‑founder Dan Houser revealed he is deliberately avoiding GTA 6’s "Extended Look" trailer and most open‑world titles. item.title: A GTA 6 Mural Is Being Painted In New York City
item.description: Rockstar Games is painting an official GTA 6 promotional mural in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, featuring main characters Jason and Lucia. The artwork is expected to be completed shortly.

item.title: Red Dead Online Halloween Event Month Begins October 6 and Runs Through November 2
item.description: Rockstar announces a Halloween Event Month in Red Dead Online from Oct 6 to Nov 2, with themed rewards, discounts and the Halloween Pass 2.

item.title: How Is A Game Like GTA 6 Actually Made? Here’s How Rockstar Gets It Done
item.description: Rockstar North boss Rob Nelson reveals GTA 6's development uses eight-week milestones, with content roughened across all areas, while teams focus on NPC depth, pedestrian dialogue, and detailed world-building for Vice City.

item.title: GTA 6 Reportedly Includes Detailed Decapitation and Drug Use, per PEGI Rating
item.description: PC Gamer reports that a hastily deleted PEGI rating suggests Grand Theft Auto 6 will feature detailed decapitation and frequent, prominent drug use, with characters able to snort cocaine directly from hand.

item.title: GTA VI Characters Appear in SNL Sketch Promoting November Release
item.description: Saturday Night Live featured a sketch promoting Grand Theft Auto VI, with cast members portraying Jason Duval and Link. The segment highlighted the game's anticipated November 2026 release and its impact on competing titles.
